why: The conjecture reduces to whether K1,2,2,2 has a finite planar cover; a Dec 2024 arXiv paper (Annor, Nikolayevsky, Payne, 'Three Theorems on Negami's Planar Cover Conjecture') proves K1,2,2,2 has no planar cover of ply below 14 and that any minimal cover must be 4-connected, narrowing the remaining case since the 26 Jan 2024 snapshot.
